_meta.purpose: Consolidated external mirror of instance-level gem:llm* annotations carried on GEM controlled-vocabulary (enumerated-value) individuals. Convenience artifact for LLM and application-developer consumers who want the per-value definitions without parsing Turtle.
_meta.authority: GEM_ontology.ttl is authoritative; this file is a derived mirror. On any conflict the ontology wins. Kept in sync by gem_audit.py's llm_annotation_drift check (its autofix regenerates this file's gem:llmDetailedDefinition map from the graph).
_meta.coverage: All five GEM controlled-vocabulary (enumerated-value) families are annotated: gem:RuleType (21), gem:RuleDomain (3), gem:RestrictionType (4), gem:NextPlannedStep (4), gem:SourceAvailability (1) — 33 individuals. No families pending. Entries expand automatically if a family gains new individuals carrying gem:llmDetailedDefinition in the ontology; a new FAMILY does not — gem_audit.py's LLM_ANNOTATED_VOCAB_CLASSES is a hand-maintained roster that must be edited when one is added (S156 finding; the S140 wording implied otherwise).
_meta.sync_note: Each individual's gem:llmDetailedDefinition is verbatim from its governing enumeration's per-value definition (drift-proof by construction): gem:RuleType and gem:RuleDomain from the gem:ruleType / gem:ruleDomain property gem:llmEnumeratedValues; gem:RestrictionType from gem:restrictionType gem:llmEnumeratedValues; gem:NextPlannedStep from the gem:NextPlannedStep class gem:llmEnumeratedValues (the class carries the detailed per-value form). ruleType folded in at S136; the other three families folded in at the S140 60-policy checkpoint. gem:SourceAvailability folded in at S156, its per-value definition verbatim from the gem:SourceAvailability class gem:llmEnumeratedValues (the class carries the detailed per-value form, as gem:NextPlannedStep does). gem:planNone's per-value definition was NARROWED at S159 (Tom): 'planNone only refers to there being no intent to take it further; no other meaning should be inferred.' The prior wording enumerated retiree classes ('_DELETED URIs, historical/superseded versions, retired-incorporated policies') as though those categories were part of its meaning, which is the inference the narrowed definition forbids; the edit was made on the gem:NextPlannedStep class's gem:llmEnumeratedValues and on the individual, and this map was regenerated by the autofix. Family count and individual count are unchanged at five and 33.
_meta.map_ordering: gem:llmDetailedDefinition entries are sorted by subject URI (canonical order; regenerated deterministically by the autofix).
